summary.en: Xcelerator is an equity-free, POC-oriented accelerator launched in 2018 by Tel Aviv University's venture arm TAU Ventures together with the Israel Security Agency (Shin Bet). Each startup receives a NIS 50,000 grant from the ISA budget without giving up equity.
summary.local: Xcelerator הוא מאיץ ללא הון, שהושק ב-2018 ע"י זרוע ההשקעות של אוניברסיטת תל אביב (TAU Ventures) יחד עם השב"כ.

sources.title: Xcelerator - Start-Up Nation Finder

sources.quote: Each startup receives $50,000, allocated out of the ISA's budget, without giving up any equity. ... The Xcelerator was founded in 2018.

sources.title: Israel Security Agency, Tel Aviv University Venture Arm Announce First Accelerator Cohort
sources.supports: first cohort size and grant amount
sources.quote: The seven participating startups ... received a no-strings-attached grant of NIS 50,000 (around $13,700) from the agency.

verification_notes: Run jointly with the Israel Security Agency; included here as a TAU (academic venture-arm) accelerator. Grant reported as NIS 50,000 (~$13,700) and elsewhere as '$50,000' — used the NIS figure with its stated USD approximation.
